title: Deterministic Test Vector
intent: Label synthetic signing and benchmark artifacts so they cannot imply production approval.
problem: Without fixed inputs and explicit TEST_VECTOR labels produce reproducible artifacts, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the deterministic test vector contract.
context: This pattern addresses cryptographic failure paths need stable fixtures; its concrete control is fixed inputs and explicit TEST_VECTOR labels produce reproducible artifacts.
forces: Correctness requires that test signatures cannot be presented as production evidence
Operational pressure can cause: random time or nonce changes the fixture
solution: Implement fixed inputs and explicit TEST_VECTOR labels produce reproducible artifacts. Verify the anchored symbol `_key` with `test_actual_api_vectors_produce_signed_canonical_release_manifest` before reuse.
invariants: test signatures cannot be presented as production evidence
repeated runs yield the same expected digest
failure_modes: random time or nonce changes the fixture
test keys are loaded by production configuration
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `random time or nonce changes the fixture` and fails closed if the deterministic test vector evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For deterministic test vector, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to fixed inputs and explicit TEST_VECTOR labels produce reproducible artifacts.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: cryptographic failure paths need stable fixtures
Do not apply when: real approvals are being issued
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: cryptographic failure paths need stable fixtures
